tasks.name: Daily Usage Export
tasks.instructions:
1. Type {{credential:utility_portal:username}} into the username or email field, type {{credential:utility_portal:password}} into the password field, then click the Login or Sign In button to submit the form. Wait 60 seconds for the page to load after login.
2. Find the Active Home dropdown and select the option "103892 0" from it. Wait 15 seconds. If a Lastpass save password prompt appears, click Never or close it.
3. Find and click the Usage History section, then find and click the More Details button. Wait 15 seconds for the page to load.
4. Find and click the Export button. When the popup appears, click PDF.
